Jobless claims averaging 198k a week this month, down 13.1% from a year ago.
GDPNow tracking 3.6% growth while median CPI sits at 2.1%.
The soft landing isn't a forecast anymore, it's the print.
$IDA holding 134, the shelf under the last two closes. Under 124 the whole base is gone.
$KRC up +1.6% today, closing over 33.6. Four green days in a row, and that level held every test.
$RYAN back above the 38 shelf, first reclaim since the June break. 40.4 is the test.
